# Stable-release obfuscation compatibility

Nightly checks out the latest stable tag, so fixes on a development branch cannot
repair an already published tag. For `v0.5.0` only, the workflow applies
`v0.5.0.patch` from its own pinned workflow commit after checking that it applies
cleanly. Other versions build directly from their tag. Release notes identify
both the source tag and the compatibility-patch revision.

The patch contains only these fixes:

- Accept `ComponentActivity` in the Compose scenario host, including the separate
  activity class generated by obfuscation. This fix already exists on the product branch.
- Open the registered scenario component from the overlay's Home action.
- Launch tutorials in the running package instead of the standard release package.

Keep the last two fixes in product sources as well. Do not copy whole files from
the development branch onto a stable release. Remove this special case once
v0.5.0 no longer needs to be rebuilt by the nightly workflow.

The Verify workflow builds an unsigned ARM64 randomized release to catch Kotlin,
Hilt and R8 failures before publishing a new stable tag.
